title: Second face found in Utopia

tellings.quote: And then I went and looked at a different part of Mars that was also on the seashore of this ocean and found another site with two faces, one of which looks like the same face inside a helmet as at Cydonia.

plain: John Brandenburg, a physicist, says that in the 1980s he studied pictures of Utopia, a region of Mars that he says once lay on the shore of an ancient ocean. He says he found a site with two faces, one looking like the same face, inside a helmet, as the well-known face seen at Cydonia, another Martian region. If true, it would mean someone built monuments on Mars long ago.
